Please be very careful with the title. The first part sounds electronic, the second moves more toward house, and later there is a mixture of house with some jazz elements.

But calling it “Persian Jazz” is taking a risk. Imagine an academically trained jazz musician listening to this. The title could almost suggest that, among nearly 90 million Iranians, this is what represents Persian jazz. Is this really Persian jazz?

The music itself is nice and I enjoyed it. My criticism is not about the quality of the music; it is about the title and the musical classification. This is not jazz, and adding Persian elements does not make it “Persian Jazz.”

I think the track deserves a title that describes what it actually does well: electronic/house music with Persian influences and some jazz-inspired elements.
